title: Finish All Courses
statement: A student must take n courses, 0 to n − 1. Each pair [a, b] in rules means course a must be taken before course b. Return true if there is an order that takes every course.

answerKey.pattern: Topological order with Kahn's algorithm (cycle detection)
keyPoints: Take courses from the queue, lowering their neighbours' in-degrees
Possible exactly when all n courses were taken
edgeCases: A cycle in one part only
acceptableSlowerApproaches: DFS with three colours to find a cycle: also O(V + E)

hints: Exactly when the rules go in a circle.
Run Kahn's algorithm and compare the number of courses taken with n.
